evidence: Enables the `-Wunused` compiler warning flag in CMakeLists.txt to enforce compiler warnings across the build.
rationale: Enabling `-Wunused` prevents silent accumulation of dead code and catches forgotten parameter usage, as seen in PR #36137 where logic had 'just been forgotten to be used'. While preventing recurring cleanup churn (evidenced by nine cited PRs like #35679 and #36009), it is an internal compiler-flag hardening change that can be reasonably deferred without blocking releases.
